<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="אלול_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518920368_theRebbe_469" batchId="meluket-_D7_90_D7_9C_D7_95_D7_9C_meluket__BH_POST_1766518920368_theRebbe_469__p005">
  <section v="12">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>After explaining the verse about Yerushalayim and strengthening the bars of your gates, the maamar explains the verses about setting your border peace and He gives snow like wool, detailing how snow and wool correspond to garments and essence in the context of sin and rectification.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">8)</t>
    <t s="1">And now, after the maamar explains the aspect of Yerushalayim etc. "for He has strengthened the bars of your gates" etc.,</t>
    <t s="2">the maamar explains the verse</t>
    <t s="3">"He sets your border peace" etc. and its connection to "for He has strengthened the bars of your gates,"</t>
    <t s="4">and afterwards the maamar explains the verse</t>
    <t s="5">"He gives snow like wool" etc.</t>
    <t s="6">And it explains,</t>
    <t s="7">that snow is the aspect of "His garments like white snow,"</t>
    <t s="8">and wool is the aspect of "the hair of His head like clean wool."</t>
    <t s="9">And this is</t>
    <t s="10">what is stated</t>
    <t s="11">"If your sins are like scarlet, they shall become white as snow; if they are red like crimson, they shall become like wool,"</t>
    <t s="12">[where] "scarlet" is a white thread that is dyed red,</t>
    <t s="13">meaning the defect is only in the garments,</t>
    <t s="14">and the rectification of this defect is through the aspect of "His garments like white snow,"</t>
    <t s="15">and "crimson" is intrinsically red,</t>
    <t s="16">meaning the defect reached the essence of the soul,</t>
    <t s="17">and in order to rectify this defect it is through the aspect of wool,</t>
    <t s="18">"the hair of His head like clean wool,"</t>
    <t s="19">for "the hair of the head" are extensions from the essence of the soul,</t>
    <t s="20">as we see,</t>
    <t s="21">that when one pulls a person by the hairs of his head, the entire body is drawn.</t>
    <t s="22">And the concept of "He gives snow like wool" is that even in snow, which is a garment, the aspect of wool—</t>
    <t s="23">essence—will be drawn.</t>
    <t s="24">And the connection of wool and snow is through a drawing from a place above them both.</t>
    <t s="25">And after the maamar explains the concept of "He gives snow like wool,"</t>
    <t s="26">it explains again</t>
    <t s="27">(with a slight variation)</t>
    <t s="28">the concept of "Judges and officers you shall appoint for yourself in all your gates,"</t>
    <t s="29">and through this it is that "He has strengthened the bars of your gates."</t>
    <t s="30">And one must understand the connection of "He gives snow like wool" to "for He has strengthened the bars of your gates."</t>
  </section>
  <section v="13">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Snow and wool each have an advantage: snow represents the thirteen rectifications of the beard (mercy) which sweeten judgments, while wool represents the hair of the head (chesed) which is above the need for sweetening judgments.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">9)</t>
    <t s="1">And this will be understood by prefacing,</t>
    <t s="2">that snow and wool,</t>
    <t s="3">each one has an advantage.</t>
    <t s="4">And the concept is,</t>
    <t s="5">that "His garments like white snow"</t>
    <t s="6">(snow)</t>
    <t s="7">are the thirteen rectifications of the beard, whose root is in the concealed brain of Arich Anpin, in which the gevurah of Atik is clothed,</t>
    <t s="8">and "the hair of His head like clean wool"</t>
    <t s="9">(wool)</t>
    <t s="10">are in the skull of Arich Anpin, in which the chesed of Atik is clothed.</t>
    <t s="11">And it is explained in the Siddur,</t>
    <t s="12">that the concept of the gevurot in the thirteen rectifications of the beard is that they come to sweeten the judgments, and judgments are only sweetened at their root,</t>
    <t s="13">and the hairs of the head,</t>
    <t s="14">which do not come to sweeten judgments</t>
    <t s="15">(for they are above the aspect of sweetening judgments),</t>
    <t s="16">are the aspect of chesed.</t>
    <t s="17">And from this it is understood,</t>
    <t s="18">that the sweetening of judgments through the thirteen rectifications of the beard,</t>
    <t s="19">since they come to sweeten the judgments,</t>
    <t s="20">therefore the sweetening relates to the lower realm</t>
    <t s="21">(to those upon whom judgments are aroused),</t>
    <t s="22">and the sweetening through the hair of the head,</t>
    <t s="23">which is above the concept of sweetening judgments,</t>
    <t s="24">is from the aspect of the chassadim within them,</t>
    <t s="25">a revelation from above.</t>
    <t s="26">And this is that the thirteen rectifications of the beard are mercy</t>
    <t s="27">(the thirteen attributes of mercy)</t>
    <t s="28">and the hair of the head is chesed,</t>
    <t s="29">for mercy is</t>
    <t s="30">(generally)</t>
    <t s="31">from that which one feels the pain of another,</t>
    <t s="32">and chesed is from one's own essence.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="14">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The hair of the head represents the essence of Israel, which is above the revealed powers of the soul; the thirteen rectifications affect the revealed powers, while the revelation of the hair of the head shows that from the perspective of the essence, no defect applies to them.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And now, from what is explained in the maamar</t>
    <t s="1">(brought above in section 8)</t>
    <t s="2">that the rectification of defects through the revelation of the hair of the head is analogous to when one pulls a person by the hairs of his head, the entire body is drawn,</t>
    <t s="3">it is proven,</t>
    <t s="4">that the aspect of the hair of the head above is the essence of Israel</t>
    <t s="5">[for since the hair of the head is the essentiality above, which is above the aspect of garments,</t>
    <t s="6">this is also the essentiality of Israel,</t>
    <t s="7">for Israel and the Holy One, blessed be He, are all one].</t>
    <t s="8">And based on this, it must be said,</t>
    <t s="9">that what was brought above, that the hair of the head is chesed</t>
    <t s="10">(and the sweetening of judgments is through a revelation from above)</t>
    <t s="11">is in relation to the revealed powers of the soul,</t>
    <t s="12">through which is the rectification and filling of the defects.</t>
    <t s="13">And the concept is,</t>
    <t s="14">that the thirteen rectifications of the beard,</t>
    <t s="15">despite being above the chain of descent,</t>
    <t s="16">nevertheless,</t>
    <t s="17">since they come to sweeten the judgments</t>
    <t s="18">(that are in the chain of descent)</t>
    <t s="19">they relate to the chain of descent.</t>
    <t s="20">And it can be said that their concept in man is the essence of the revealed powers.</t>
    <t s="21">Therefore,</t>
    <t s="22">the revelation of the thirteen rectifications of the beard acts upon the revealed powers of the soul.</t>
    <t s="23">And the aspect of the hair of the head is the essentiality above, which is above the essence of the revealed powers</t>
    <t s="24">[and this is what is stated in the maamar</t>
    <t s="25">(brought above in section 8)</t>
    <t s="26">that the revelation of the aspect of the hair of the head is effective even when the defect reached the essence of the soul,</t>
    <t s="27">for the essence in which the defect occurred is the essence that relates to the revelations,</t>
    <t s="28">and the aspect of the hair of the head is the very essence of the soul,</t>
    <t s="29">in which defect is not applicable].</t>
    <t s="30">And since the essence is separate from the revelations,</t>
    <t s="31">it cannot act upon them.</t>
    <t s="32">And the rectification of defects in the revealed powers through the revelation of the aspect of the hair of the head,</t>
    <t s="33">is,</t>
    <t s="34">that it is revealed in them,</t>
    <t s="35">that from the perspective of the essence of the soul, defect is not applicable,</t>
    <t s="36">for even at the time of sin it is faithful to Him, blessed be He,</t>
    <t s="37">and since the essence of the soul is their essence,</t>
    <t s="38">therefore even the defects within them are only in the external aspect.</t>
    <t s="39">And this is,</t>
    <t s="40">that the rectification of defects through the thirteen rectifications of the beard is that the essence relating to the revealed powers acts upon them,</t>
    <t s="41">in their form.</t>
    <t s="42">And the rectification of defects through the aspect of the hair of the head is that it is revealed in them that from the perspective of the essence</t>
    <t s="43">(of them)</t>
    <t s="44">defect is not applicable to them,</t>
    <t s="45">but this does not relate so much to the matter of the revealed powers themselves,</t>
    <t s="46">to their form.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
